QuestInfo.name: Spiegelmann's Connections?
QuestInfo.0: You have found an Old Picture of Spiegelmann in the #t2430290# from the Monster Park. Go ask Spiegelmann about it.
QuestInfo.1: You have found an Old Picture of Spiegelmann in the #t2430290# from the Monster Park. Go ask Spiegelmann about it.
QuestInfo.2: Spiegelmann dodged your questions. It seems he is trying to hide something. How does Spigelmann know Von Leon, and what do they have to do with each other?

0.0: Hello there! Are you enjoying your visit to the Monster Park? I do hope so. Now, what can I help you with?\r\n#L0##b(You take a deep, steady breath.) I found an Old Envelope inside one of the Monster Park dungeons. There was an Old Picture in it...a picture of you, Spiegelmann...#l\n#k
0.1: A picture of me, you say? Interesting! May I take a look? (He peers at the picture.) This is quite old...wait, is that...?\r\n#L0##bIt's you and Von Leon! What's this all about?#l\n#k
0.2: Heh, you...you think that's actually me? Don't be absurd! I think I would remember meeting this Von... Von...what did you say his name was?\r\n#L0##bBut, but, this looks just like you! Why are you playing dumb?#l\n#k
0.3: Hmm, now wait a minute. I might remember something...

1.0: (His eyes start to grow wide, like he has suddenly remembered something.)\r\n#L0##bDo you remember now? This was in that envelope you were looking for. How do you know Von Leon?#l\n#k
1.1: I...I'm sorry, but I really don't remember. I guess the envelope you opened was not the one I wanted. It must be someone who looks just like me. I had no idea such a person existed! I think I will keep this picture as a souvenir.

yes.0: It's such a nice day, so why bother worrying about silly things like that? Here, I'll even  give you a commemorative coin as a gift. Well, have fun! I'm busy, so please excuse me.
